description: Commit-bound record of real iOS Simulator / Android Emulator runs from .github/workflows/native-smoke.yml. capabilities/public-claims.js counts entries with verified:true — a run only flips the public 'native evidence' claim from source-conformance-only to device-verified once it is actually recorded here from a real, passing CI run. Do not hand-author verified:true entries; that would be exactly the fabricated-proof pattern PROOF_STANDARD.md and LIMITATIONS.md exist to prevent.
